prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished original geometric background for an AI-learning website. Wide landscape 3:2 canvas, 1536 x 1024. Generate completely from scratch using the design below.

Create an exquisitely finished mathematical folded-paper / prismatic bas-relief mosaic. It should feel like a beautifully constructed architectural origami tessellation with intricate nested diamonds and a woven rhythm of triangular facets. Precise geometry, polished editorial CGI, calm and sophisticated.

COMPOSITION
Uniform pale dusty-lilac background (#e8e0f1). The left 58 percent, especially the upper-left and center-left, remains spacious and entirely blank for website copy. The MAIN cluster is a broad, connected, stepped diagonal mosaic growing from the lower-middle edge toward the middle and lower right edges. It occupies roughly the lower-right 45 percent of the composition. Its silhouette is made from purposeful square/diamond steps, not a rectangular panel. A smaller matching mosaic island sits at the extreme upper-right corner, partly cropped by the top/right frame, with a generous empty lilac gap separating it from the main cluster. Five to seven prominent nested diamond motifs in the main mosaic; two in the upper-right island. A few small, completely formed four-facet diamond satellites sit just outside the stepped border. Geometry can be cropped ONLY at the canvas edge; every object inside the canvas is finished and fully constructed.

TWO-LEVEL GEOMETRIC GRAMMAR
1. Base weave: one precise orthogonal square grid. Square tiles are divided into broad, perfectly planar triangular facets using exact diagonals. Neighboring triangles form an orderly alternating zigzag of violet, lilac, teal and occasional citron faces. All adjacent tile edges line up, and all seams meet at intentional shared vertices. The woven character comes from alternating triangular planes and diagonal color bands, never from tangled ribbons. Every triangle has three straight edges and three clean corners.
2. Nested diamond medallions: square forms rotated exactly 45 degrees. Each consists of a plum central FOUR-sided pyramid (four flat triangular faces meeting at one centered apex), surrounded by TWO concentric square diamond bevel-rings of identical construction. The inner bevel ring is pale lilac, the outer ring lavender with shaded plum facets. All three diamonds share the same center, exact orientation and regular proportions. Bevel widths are consistent on all four sides, with crisp mitered corners. Centers are registered to the same base grid. Repeat this same carefully designed medallion at a uniform main scale; smaller satellites use the central four-facet diamond alone. The medallions remain distinct and complete; surrounding mosaic facets terminate cleanly at their outer boundaries. Clean shallow layered relief, coherent elevation and overlap ordering.

PALETTE AND MATERIAL
Dominant lavender and soft grey-violet (#b8a6cb, #9c89b4), dark muted plum recesses (#66516f), pale lilac highlights (#e9e0ee), restrained muted sage-teal (#88b7af) on a few broad triangular faces, and sparse pale citron (#dce0a3) on just a few matching facets. These are discrete clean regions, no rainbow blending. Smooth satin-matte surfaces, no visible grain or fibrous texture. Thin pale crease highlights generated by actual geometry, not thick drawn outlines. Soft believable contact shadows with one consistent light source from the upper left. Orthographic overhead view, only shallow sculptural depth.

FINISHING REQUIREMENTS
The result must read like professionally modeled, fully resolved CAD geometry. Every prism, beveled ring and folded tile is complete. Every facet is planar; every straight edge stays straight; every diagonal junction is precise. Clear separation of neighboring forms. Exact central alignment of nested diamonds. No mashed or pinched motifs, accidental asymmetry, wavy edges, bent polygons, missing faces, broken corners, unfinished line segments, doubled seams, fused objects, random slivers, tiny filler triangles, wrinkled folds, hovering shards, cracks, dirty smudges, texture noise, grain, soft blurry geometry or contradictory shadows. Rich geometric detail comes from a consistent repeatable construction, not random ornament. No organic curls, curved petals, bubbles, ribbons, hexagons, chrome, glossy plastic, glow, neon, letters, words, logos, watermark, border, frame or interface.
